claim: Slugifying the title 'Café Münster 2024' gives 'caf-m-nster-2024': the accented letters are dropped, not kept.
why: The README says slugify keeps letters and digits, which suggests accented letters survive. The code lowercases the title and keeps only characters found in string.ascii_lowercase plus string.digits, so the precomposed (NFC) letters e-acute and u-umlaut become separators and the result is 'caf-m-nster-2024' (a decomposed NFD title would give a different string; the claim uses the NFC form). The trap is trusting the word letters in the README and the helper's name over the ASCII-only set it checks.

deciding.note: the regex class excludes accented letters
